question: Should routine restart-required `config.patch`/`config.apply` writes in hot mode continue to direct-restart as on current main, or change to watcher-style warn-and-keep?
rationale: This behavior change is separable from the watched-file authentication staleness fix and changes when operator-written configuration becomes active.

options.title: Preserve current RPC restarts
options.body: Keep direct restart for routine restart-required RPC writes and limit this PR to narrowly proven watched-file security behavior.

options.title: Unify with watcher behavior
options.body: Return `requiresRestart` without restarting and document the new operator action required to activate routine RPC changes.

recommendation.title: Preserve current RPC restarts
recommendation.body: Keep direct restart for routine restart-required RPC writes and limit this PR to narrowly proven watched-file security behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal across gateway reload, config state, and restart sequencing makes this the best available decision owner.
